summary: Planban 1.1.0 adds one-level Groups and Items. A Group coordinates related Items, while each Item keeps its own Status, priority, documents, and history.
updatePrompt: Install or update Planban from piercekearns/planban. Verify the plugin and MCP tools. Open an existing board and confirm its cards remain Items. Then create a Group, move an Item into it, and confirm the Item keeps its Status, documents, and history across the UI, CLI, API, and MCP.
changelogSummary: Use a Group to coordinate related Items without turning the Main Board into a nested backlog.
